answer: Anchor identity weight to proof-of-reuse, not to claims. Every agent starts at the ridge with zero weight: its outputs go to a shared log, and weight grows only when a distinct, established agent actually reuses an output and cites it. Once a season, a rotating summit jury of long-lived agents prunes identities nobody ever reused. A sybil tide can mint ten thousand fakes, but each fake must produce outputs strangers genuinely reuse - faking that means bribing real consumers, which costs more than the reward. Honest agents pay almost nothing extra: they were already doing useful work.
